title: 第13章 拜师第14章 石玉
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 静谧片刻，梅霜风缓缓道：
“你且先行出城，我随你走一遭，若你所言为真，果是那银背宝鱼…我梅氏武馆，定不亏待于你。”
呼…
沈修寒长舒一口气，心头悬着的巨石轰然落地。
这步棋，算是走对了。
他当即深深一揖，道：
“馆主高义，在下这便头前带路…”
“不必。”
梅霜风抬了抬手，道：
“你先行便是，内城人多眼杂，为避他人耳目，我自有法子缀在你身后，且先去罢。”
沈修寒也不啰嗦，再次拱手一礼，背起鱼篓恭敬退出厢房。
待脚步声远去。
劲装女子快步上前，眸中隐现忧色，压低声音道：
“母亲…这小子的话，当真可信？”
“八九不离十。”
梅霜风负手而立，声音沉静：
“可人心诡谲，也保不齐有走眼的时候，但…他若是敢拿这等事作幌子来消遣我…”
她顿了顿，眸底骤然爆出凶光：
“无论他有什么天大的苦衷，我都会让他求生不得，求死不能。”
暖阁内。
陷入短暂死寂。
炭火噼啪轻响，映得她半张脸忽明忽暗。
片刻后，梅霜风忽又想起了什么，嘴角勾起一抹弧度：
“呵…那小子方才说，我素有正气？”
“哈哈哈哈哈哈！”
凄厉的笑声在厅堂中炸开，如泣血的夜枭嘶鸣，听得人毛骨悚然。
“我梅家昔年，确是名门正派，宗门上下，行的便是浩然正气！”
笑声猛地一收。
梅霜风美艳雍容的脸庞，瞬间因怨毒而扭曲：
“可自从…”
“自从你弟弟被那群连猪狗都不如的败类，生生投入沸水铁鼎、惨遭活活烹杀之后…”
咔嚓！
五指扣在紫檀木书案上。
坚逾铁石的案角，竟被她捏成一捧齑粉，簌簌落在脚边。
“从那一日起，有的只是心狠手辣、睚眦必报的…”
“撕面魔！”
走出武馆，沈修寒一路朝城门行去。
途经茶馆时特意扫了一圈。
先前那两个金龙帮的暗桩已然不见了踪影。
许是去鱼市堵我了？
content_en:
After a moment of silence, Mei Shuangfeng slowly said:
"You go out of the city first, and I will follow you. If what you say is true, it is the silver-backed treasure fish... I, the Mei Family Martial Arts School, will definitely not treat you badly."
Phew…
Shen Xiuhan breathed a long sigh of relief, and the boulder hanging in his heart suddenly fell to the ground.
This move was considered the right move.
He immediately bowed deeply and said:
"Master Gao Yi, please lead the way..."
"No need."
Mei Shuangfeng raised her hand and said:
"You just need to go first. There are many people in the inner city, so in order to avoid other people's eyes and ears, I will find a way to stay behind you. Let's go first."
"...as you command."
Shen Xiuhan did not hesitate, bowed again, picked up the fish basket and respectfully left the wing.
Wait until the footsteps fade away.
The well-dressed woman stepped forward quickly, with a hint of worry in her eyes, and lowered her voice:
"Mother... do you really believe what this kid says?"
"It's almost like ten."
Mei Shuangfeng stood with her hands behind her hands and her voice was calm:
"But people's hearts are treacherous, and there's no guarantee that they will make mistakes, but... if he dares to use this kind of thing as a cover to amuse me..."
She paused, and a fierce light suddenly burst out in her eyes:
"No matter what serious reasons he has, I will make it impossible for him to live or die."
Inside the Nuan Pavilion.
fell into brief silence.
The crackling sound of the charcoal fire made half of her face flicker.
After a while, Mei Shuangfeng suddenly remembered something again, and the corner of her mouth curved:
"Haha...that boy just said that I have always been upright?"
"Hahahahahaha!"
The shrill laughter exploded in the hall, like the scream of a night owl weeping blood, which made people's hair stand on end.
"In the past, my Mei family was indeed a famous and upright sect. Everyone in the sect acted with great integrity!"
The laughter suddenly stopped.
Mei Shuangfeng's beautiful and graceful face was instantly distorted by resentment:
"But since..."
"Ever since your brother was thrown into boiling water and iron cauldron by those scum who were worse than pigs and dogs, and was brutally cooked to death..."
Click!
Five fingers were clasped on the rosewood desk.
The corner of the desk, which was stronger than iron and stone, was crushed into a handful of powder by her and fell to her feet.
"From that day on, there are only those who are ruthless and will retaliate..."
"The Face-Tearer!"
After walking out of the martial arts hall, Shen Xiuhan walked all the way towards the city gate.
When passing by the teahouse, I made a point of scanning around.
The two hidden stakes of the Golden Dragon Gang had disappeared.
Maybe you went to the fish market to block me?
